fields.name: Adept of Aqueous Fusion

trait.name: Fusionist Spellcasting (4/Short or Long Rest)
trait.text:
When the adept casts one of its limited-use spells, it can augment the spell to create an effect in a sphere up to 20 feet in radius. The sphere is centered on the target of a spell or, if the spell has an area of effect, on the point where the area is centered. The effect must contain one of the spell's elements, which is listed in parentheses after the spell.

	Ice (Air, Water). All surfaces in the area become covered in slick ice until the end of the adept's next turn. When the ice appears, each creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

	Mud (Earth, Water). The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain until cleaned. When the mud appears, each creature standing in the area has its speed reduced by 15 feet until it or another creature uses its action to clean an affected creature.

	Steam (Fire, Water). The area is heavily obscured by scalding steam until the end of the adept's next turn. A creature that ends its turn in the area takes 2 (1d4) fire damage per level of the spell.

trait.name: Water Affinity
trait.text: When the adept casts a spell from the Water Spells list (see page 165), these are automatically cast two levels higher than their normal level (included in Spells). The adept can change the damage type dealt by any spell it casts to cold.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The adept is a 6th-level spellcaster. It uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The adept has the following bender spells prepared:

	• At will: concussion, ray of frost, smokescreen , water whip
	• 3/day each: bloodweave (water, 4th-level), ice moon (water, 3rd-level), misty step (air, 2nd-level), shield (earth, 1st-level)
	• 1/day each: acid rain (water, 5th-level), hold person (water, 4th-level), lightning bolt (fire, 3rd-level), water wyrm (water, 5th-level)

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The adept makes two attacks with any combination of Shortsword and Elemental Strike.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Elemental Strike
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) cold damage for a melee attack, or 6 (1d4 + 4) cold damage for a ranged attack.

action.name: Concussion
action.text: Saving Throw: DC 15 Constitution, range 60 ft., one creature the adept can see. Failure: 13 (3d8) thunder damage, and the target is deafened until the start of the adept's next turn.

action.name: Ray of Frost
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) cold damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the adept's next turn.

action.name: Elemental Combo (Bonus Action)
action.text: After the adept casts one of its limited-use spells or makes a Shortsword or Elemental Strike attack on its turn, it makes one Elemental Strike attack. This attack deals 11 (3d4 + 4) cold damage for a melee attack or 7 (3d4) cold damage for a ranged attack.

fields.spells: Concussion (TP), Ray of Frost, Smokescreen (TP), Water Whip (TP), Bloodweave (HB), Ice Moon (HB), Misty Step, Shield, Acid Rain (Ryoko) (HB), Hold Person, Lightning Bolt, Water Wyrm
fields.description:
The adept of aqueous fusion is a Disciple of Fusion bender with water affinity. It is an offensive spellcaster that begins combat by casting hold person, creating a mud field with Fusionist Spellcasting, and then taking advantage of its paralyzed foes by casting lightning bolt. Until its hold person spell ends, it relies on ice moon to inflict damage, creating an acid rain cloud and mud surface. When casting lightning bolt or ice moon, it uses Fusionist Spellcasting to create a heavily obscuring steam cloud it can hide behind. It tries to stay out of melee, using its superior movement and misty step to position itself advantageously, but will summon a water wyrm if cornered. When retreating, it makes liberal use of the smokescreen cantrip.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 358 (Indie)

fields.name: Disciple of Ferocious Dust

trait.name: Destructive Nature (1/Turn)
trait.text: When the disciple hits a creature with an attack, it can spend one use of one of its spells to deal an extra 9 (2d8) acid, bludgeoning, or thunder damage (disciple's choice when it uses this trait).

trait.name: Pole Vaulter
trait.text: While wielding a Reach weapon, if the disciple walks at least 10 feet immediately before jumping, its jumping distance is tripled. In addition, while wielding a Reach weapon, it can subtract up to 50 feet from its fall when calculating fall damage.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The disciple is a 4th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The disciple has the following bender spells prepared from the air and earth elemental affinity lists:

	• At will: concussion*, dash strike*, earthen fist*
	• 2/day: misty step
	• 1/day each: blur, earthen uppercut*, entangle, longstrider(p), magic missile (deals acid, bludgeoning, or thunder damage instead of force)

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration; p = pre-cast before combat

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The disciple makes two attacks with any combination of Glaive and Elemental Strike. It can replace one of these attacks with a cantrip with a casting time of one action or Whirling Strike.

action.name: Glaive
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Elemental Strike
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) acid, bludgeoning, or thunder damage (disciple's choice) for a melee attack, or 5 (1d4 + 3) damage for a ranged attack.
attack: Melee Acid, Bludgeoning, Or Thunder Damage|+5|1d6+3
Ranged Acid, Bludgeoning, Or Thunder Damage|+5|1d4+3

action.name: Whirling Strike (2/Day)
action.text: Each creature within 10 feet of the disciple must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Success or failure, a creature can't make opportunity attacks against the disciple until the end of this turn.

action.name: Elemental Combo (Bonus Action)
action.text: After the disciple casts one of its limited-use spells or makes a Glaive or Elemental Strike attack on its turn, it makes one Elemental Strike attack. This attack deals 8 (2d4 + 3) acid, bludgeoning, or thunder damage (disciple's choice) for a melee attack or 5 (2d4) damage for a ranged attack.
attack: Melee Acid, Bludgeoning, Or Thunder Damage||2d4+3
Ranged Acid, Bludgeoning, Or Thunder Damage||2d4

fields.spells: Concussion (TP), Dash Strike (HB), Earthen Fist (HB), Misty Step, Blur, Earthen Uppercut (HB), Entangle, Longstrider, Magic Missile
fields.description:
The disciple of ferocious dust is a Disciple of Ferocity bender that has affinity with air and earth. It combines the long reach of its glaive with movement-enhancing spells such as longstrider and misty step to conduct devastating hit-and-run tactics. If ambushing a target, the disciple begins combat with longstrider in effect and casts entangle to immobilize foes. On a subsequent turn, it uses either earthen fist or earthen uppercut to knock restrained foes prone. Using its Pole Vaulter trait, it leaps over this difficult terrain to move in for the kill. In retreat, the disciple uses blur and misty step, living to fight another day.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 359 (Indie)

fields.name: Avatar of Invigorating Elements

trait.name: Blessed Aura
trait.text: Each creature of the avatar's choice within 30 feet of the avatar is under the effects of the bless spell.

trait.name: Distracting Onslaught (5/Day) (1/Turn)
trait.text: When the avatar deals acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage to a creature, it can create a distracting array. The next time that creature makes an attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn, the creature must roll a d8 and subtract the value from the result.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
trait.text: The avatar is always under the effects of the freedom of movement spell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the avatar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Primordial Avatar State (1/Day)
trait.text: If the avatar would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 150, it gains 40 temporary hit points, its AC increases to 19, its attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) fire or lightning damage on a hit (avatar's choice when it makes the attack), and it gains a flying, walking, and swimming speed of 60 feet. Additionally, the avatar can now use the options in the "Avatar Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 11,500 XP (23,000 XP total) for defeating the avatar after its Primordial Avatar State activates.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The avatar is a 9th-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The avatar has the following bender spells prepared:

	• At will: calm air*(c) , calm earth*(c) , calm flames*(c) , calm waters*(c)
	• 3/day each: haste(c)(p), flaming tiger leap*, flashbang*, misty step, shield
	• 2/day each: cone of cold, cyclone*(c) , steelskin*(p) , Raiko's rending rage*

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration; p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The avatar has two other spells of 1st level or higher from any bender spell list prepared (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The avatar makes four attacks with any combination of Unarmed Strike and Elemental Strike.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Elemental Strike
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (avatar's choice) for a melee attack, or 7 (1d4 + 5) damage for a ranged attack.
attack: Melee Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Or Thunder Damage|+10|1d6+5
Ranged Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Or Thunder Damage|+10|1d4+5

action.name: Elemental Combo (Bonus Action)
action.text: After the avatar casts one of its limited-use spells or makes an unarmed strike or Elemental Strike attack on its turn, it makes one Elemental Strike attack. This attack deals 15 (4d4 + 5) acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (avatar's choice) for a melee attack or 10 (4d4) damage for a ranged attack.
attack: Melee Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Or Thunder Damage||4d4+5
Ranged Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Or Thunder Damage||4d4

reaction.name: Primordial Pulse
reaction.text: Trigger: A creature the avatar can see within 30 feet of it misses an attack roll or fails a saving throw. Response: The avatar grants the creature a rejuvenating boost. The creature immediately rerolls the attack roll or saving throw, with a +5 bonus.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions
legendary.text: The avatar can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The avatar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn

legendary.name: Leaping Strike
legendary.text: The avatar leaps up to 25 feet without provoking opportunity attacks and can then make one Unarmed Strike or Elemental Strike attack.

legendary.name: Invigorate (5/Day)
legendary.text: The avatar restores 15 hit points to a creature it can see within 30 feet of it.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The avatar casts a spell.

legendary.name: Avatar Actions
legendary.text: If the avatar's Primordial Avatar State trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Avatar Actions)
legendary.text: The avatar casts one of the following spells: bloodweave*, mireball*, wind strike*, or wanyūdō's fury*.

legendary.name: Mass Invigorate (5/Day) (Avatar Actions)
legendary.text: The avatar restores 15 hit points to up to three different creatures it can see within 30 feet of it.

fields.spells: Calm Air (HB), Calm Earth (HB), Calm Flames (HB), Calm Waters (HB), Haste, Flaming Tiger Leap (HB), Flashbang (HB), Misty Step, Shield, Cone of Cold, Cyclone (HB), Steelskin (HB), Raiko's Rending Rage (HB), Bloodweave (HB), Mireball (TP), Wind Strike (HB), Or Wanyūdō's Fury (HB)
fields.description:
The avatar of invigorating elements is a Disciple of Invigoration bender that has affinity with all four elements. It typically fights with other creatures that benefit from its Blessed Aura trait, Primordial Pulse reaction, and Invigorate legendary action. If ambushing, the avatar will typically pre-cast haste and steelskin on itself and begin combat with flashbang if it has nonlethal intent, or cone of cold if it aims to kill. After an enemy takes its turn, the avatar performs a Leaping Strike legendary action against that creature so that it can trigger its Distracting Onslaught trait and impose a d8 penalty to one of the enemy's rolls. On its next turn, the avatar chooses an area spell to affect as many affected enemies as possible. If it can't target more than one creature with its area of effect, it resorts to Elemental Strikes, using misty step to better locate itself for the next round of combat.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 360 (Indie)

fields.name: Shrine Warden Curator

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The shrine warden is an 8th-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The shrine warden has the following cleric spells prepared:

	• At will: guidance(c) , light, sacred flame
	• 3/day each: bless(c)(p), cure wounds, guiding bolt, silence(c) , spiritual weapon
	• 1/day each: extract shirikodama*, glyph of warding(p) , guardian of faith

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration, p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The shrine warden has three other cleric spells of 1st level or higher prepared (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Warhammer
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Sacred Flame
action.text: Saving Throw: DC 14 Dexterity, range 60 ft., one creature the shrine warden can see. Failure: 9 (2d8) radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

action.name: Consecration (1 per short or long rest) (Bonus Action)
action.text:
The shrine warden conjures a shrine at a point on the ground that it can see within 60 feet of itself that radiates magic in a 20-foot radius. It chooses up to four creatures it can see to be affected by one of the following effects:

	Blessing of Power. When an affected creature in the aura hits a target with an attack roll, it can deal an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage to that target. It then can't gain this benefit again until the start of its next turn.

	Curse of Panic. An affected creature that attempts to enter the aura for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the shrine until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shrine Guardian (4/Day)
reaction.text: Trigger: A creature in the shrine warden's shrine's aura makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Response: The shrine warden rolls a d4 and applies it as a bonus or penalty (shrine warden's choice) to the creature's roll.

fields.spells: Guidance, Light, Sacred Flame, Bless, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Silence, Spiritual Weapon, Extract Shirikodama (HB), Glyph of Warding, Guardian of Faith
fields.description:
The shrine warden curator is a cleric that specializes in supporting its team and preparing traps for foes. The shrine warden casts glyph of warding (typically choosing Explosive Runes with thunder damage) in preparation for an ambush, and casts bless on itself and its allies moments before combat begins. It likes to begin combat by summoning a guardian of faith and using its Consecration bonus action to summon a Curse of Panic shrine. From this safe haven, it creates a spiritual weapon and casts guiding bolt and extract shirikodama. If fighting spellcasters, it carefully positions its silence spell to force them to choose between taking damage from the guardian of faith, or being unable to cast spells with verbal components.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 362 (Indie)

fields.name: Yokai Druid Kincaller

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The druid is a 12th-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The druid has the following druid spells prepared:

	• At will: concussion*, druidcraft, shillelagh, smokescreen*(c)
	• 3/day each: cure wounds, depth charge*, earthskin*(p), lifesap aura*(p), longstrider(p)
	• 1/day each: dominate person(c), lion's roar*(c), eruption*, Nomi's adamantine carapace*(c)

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration; p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The druid has eight other druid spells of 1st level or higher prepared (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Quarterstaff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 +1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shillelagh
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The druid can only make this attack if it has cast shillelagh on its quarterstaff.

action.name: Concussion
action.text: Saving Throw: DC 16 Dexterity, range 60 ft., one creature the druid can see. Failure: 13 (3d8) thunder damage, and the target is deafened until the start of the druid's next turn.

reaction.name: Yokai Wild Shape (2 times)
reaction.text:
Trigger: The druid casts a spell with a casting time of one action. Response: The druid transforms into a Beast, Celestial, Construct, Fey, Fiend, or Plant that has the Yokai tag and a CR no higher than 2 for up to 6 hours (such as a stone komainu or kappa, see table on page 177).
	While in a new form, the druid's stat block is replaced by the stat block of that form, except the druid keeps its Spells section, languages, and ability to speak. While in this form, it has advantage on Constitution saving throws, and spells it casts don't require somatic or material components. The druid reverts to its true form if it falls unconscious, drops to 0 hit points, or dies. The druid can revert to its true form using a bonus action.

fields.spells: Concussion (TP), Druidcraft, Shillelagh, Smokescreen (TP), Cure Wounds, Depth Charge (TP), Earthskin (HB), Lifesap Aura (HB), Longstrider, Dominate Person, Lion's Roar (HB), Eruption (Ryoko) (HB), Nomi's Adamantine Carapace (HB)
fields.description:
This druid is a frontline specialist. When ambushing, it imbues itself with non-concentration spells, such as longstrider, lifesap aura, and earthskin, before barreling into the enemy, often in the Wild Shape form of a protective stone komainu or grappling kappa. The spell it casts on its first turn in combat depends on its intention; if it aims to soak foes' attacks, it casts Nomi's adamantine carapace. If it has lethal intent, it casts lion's roar. If its aim is to control the opposition, it casts dominate person.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 363 (Indie)

fields.name: Skeletal Warblade

trait.name: One with Nothing (1/Day)
trait.text: When the warblade is reduced to 0 hit points, it instead is reduced to 1 hit point and immediately teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, leaving behind a plume of mist.

trait.name: Skeletal Form
trait.text: The warblade's reach is 10 feet, its melee attacks deal an extra 4 (1d8) necrotic damage (included in the attacks), and it gains 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. In addition, when a creature starts its turn grappled by the warblade, the creature takes 13 (2d12) magical piercing damage. The warblade can't be disarmed of its Osseous Spike.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The warblade makes three Osseous Spike or Javelin attacks. It can use Skewer in place of two of these attacks.

action.name: Osseous Spike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) magical piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Javelin
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage for a melee attack.

action.name: Skewer (3/Day)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) magical piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the target is grappled by the warblade (escape DC 15). This grapple ends early if the warblade uses the weapon to make another attack. When the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (3d8) piercing damage.

action.name: Blitzer (Bonus Action)
action.text: The warblade attempts to shove or grapple a creature within its reach

action.name: Disengage (Bonus Action)
action.text: The warblade takes the Disengage action.

fields.description:
The skeletal warblade is a fighter that specializes in locking down and isolating targets before finishing them off. It starts combat by flying over any melee enemies and using Skewer to grapple the enemy with the lowest Strength score, using its Blitzer bonus action to try again if Skewer misses. The next round, it Disengages (as a bonus action) and Dashes upwards, using the grappled creature to provide half-cover against ranged attacks originating from below it.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 364 (Indie)

fields.name: Novice of the Fifth Gate

trait.name: Distant Striker
trait.text: The normal and long ranges of attacks the novice makes with Thrown weapons is doubled (included in the attacks), and if it misses with a Thrown weapon attack while hidden, its position is not revealed.

trait.name: Nimble Duelist
trait.text: Creatures the novice hits with a melee attack using its Meteor Hammer (or any other Finesse weapon) can't make opportunity attacks against it until the end of the turn.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
trait.text: While the novice is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The novice makes two attacks with any combination of Unarmed Strike, Meteor Hammer, and Shuriken. It can use Whirling Strike in place of one attack.

action.name: Meteor Hammer
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) magical bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shuriken
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Whirling Strike (2/Day)
action.text: Each creature within 10 feet of the novice must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Success or failure, a creature can't make opportunity attacks against the novice until the end of the turn.

action.name: Ki (8/Short or Long Rest) (Bonus Action)
action.text:
The novice performs one of the following:

	Flurry of Blows (After Multiattack action). The novice makes two Unarmed Strike attacks.

	Patient Defense. The novice takes the Dodge action and gains 2 temporary hit points.

	Step of the Wind. The novice takes the Dash and Disengage actions and gains 2 temporary hit points. Until the end of its turn, its jump distance is doubled.

reaction.name: Deflect Missiles
reaction.text: Trigger: The novice takes damage from a ranged weapon attack. Response: The novice reduces the damage taken by 13 (1d10 + 8). If the damage is reduced to 0, it can expend one use of Ki (see Bonus Actions) to make a ranged attack (range 20/60 ft.) with the weapon or piece of ammunition it deflected as part of this reaction (+4 to hit, 5 (1d6 + 2) damage on a hit).

reaction.name: Slow Fall
reaction.text: Trigger: The novice takes falling damage. Response: The novice reduces the damage taken by 30.

fields.description:
The novice of the fifth gate is a monk that follows the Way of Eight Gates. To stealthily pick off targets, it uses its shuriken and Distant Striker trait to remain unseen. In a blitzing ambush, it uses its high speed and Step of the Wind to find a place amongst many enemies where it can use its Whirling Strike. In combat, it uses Patient Defense when it has no temporary hit points, and otherwise uses Flurry of Blows. If acting as an assassin, it may use only its Flurry of Blows, fleeing as soon as its task is accomplished. When fleeing, it makes use of Step of the Wind.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 365 (Indie)

fields.name: Yojimbo Knight
fields.save: Str +7, Dex +3, Con +6, Int +3, Wis +7, Cha +9

trait.name: Aura of Protection
trait.text: Whenever the knight or a creature of its choice within 10 feet of it makes a saving throw, the creature gains a +3 bonus to the saving throw. The knight must be conscious to grant this bonus.

trait.name: Direct Damage
trait.text: The knight's Warhammer attacks bypass temporary hit points, and, if it hits a creature that is concentrating on a spell with a Warhammer attack, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw made to maintain its concentration.

trait.name: Inner Divinity
trait.text: Whenever the knight hits a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 4 (1d8) radiant damage (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Smite (3/Day)
trait.text: When the knight hits a creature with a melee attack, it can deal an extra 9 (2d8) radiant damage to the creature.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The knight is a 6th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The knight has the following paladin spells prepared:

	• 2/day each: cure wounds, shield of faith(c), shielding word*
	• 1/day each: earthskin*(p), lifesap aura*(p), spirit guardians(c), switcheroo*

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration, p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The knight has two other paladin spells of 1st level or higher prepared (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The knight makes two Warhammer or Javelin attacks. It can use Shockwave in place of one of these attacks.

action.name: Warhammer
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn (this effect can stack).

action.name: Javelin
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage for a melee attack.

action.name: Shockwave (3/Day)
action.text: Each creature within 10 feet of the knight must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet directly away from the knight.

action.name: Lay on Hands (60 Charges/Day)
action.text: The knight touches a non-Undead, non-Construct creature within its reach and spends any number of charges to restore an equal number of hit points to the creature. Alternatively, it can expend 5 charges to cure the target of one disease or neutralise one poison affecting it. It can cure multiple diseases and neutralise multiple poisons with a single use of Lay on Hands, expending charges separately for each one.

reaction.name: Daring Protector
reaction.text: Trigger: A creature makes a melee attack against another creature within 10 feet of the knight. Response: The knight moves up to its speed towards the attacker. If it ends its movement within 5 feet of the attacker, the knight becomes the target of the attack instead.

reaction.name: Guardian's Intervention (1 per short or long rest)
reaction.text: Trigger: A creature the knight can see within 30 feet of it takes damage from an attack. Response: The knight reduces the damage taken by 33 (6d10). If this reduces the damage to 0, the creature can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against the creature that attacked it.

fields.spells: Cure Wounds, Shield of Faith, Shielding Word (TP), Earthskin (HB), Lifesap Aura (HB), Spirit Guardians, Switcheroo
fields.description:
The yojimbo knight is a juggernaut of a paladin sworn to the Oath of Yojimbo. In combat, its role is to position itself within 10 feet of its most vulnerable allies, giving them the benefit of its Aura of Protection and allowing the knight to use its Daring Protector reaction to become the target of melee attacks. Its allies know this and stick close. For those beyond the range of this reaction, it uses the shielding word spell. It restores 50 hit points with its first use of Lay on Hands, saving its final 10 charges to revive a downed ally.
	When it ambushes a target, the knight casts lifesap aura and earthskin just before springing its trap. Offensively, it casts spirit guardians and positions itself in the midst of its enemies to take advantage of its Shockwave action, weathering any opportunity attacks this repositioning may trigger. If enemies are too scattered for the aforementioned tactics, it targets spellcasters with its attacks and Smite trait. The yojimbo knight is often the last to flee, letting its allies make good their escape.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 366 (Indie)

fields.name: Rōnin Scarred

trait.name: Land's Stride
trait.text: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs the rōnin no extra movement, and it can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them or taking damage from them.

trait.name: Masterless
trait.text: The rōnin has advantage on saving throws made to avoid the charmed condition.

trait.name: Slash Draw
trait.text: Twice per turn, the rōnin can draw or stow a weapon, no action required. The first time each turn that it hits a creature with a weapon it drew that turn, it deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage. The rōnin has at least two wakizashis.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The rōnin is a 4th-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The rōnin knows the following ranger spells:

	• 2/day each: cure wounds, hunter's mark(c), longstrider(p)
	• 1/day each: earthskin*(p), expeditious retreat(c), snakebite*(c)

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration; p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The rōnin knows two other ranger spells of 1st level or higher (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The rōnin makes three Wakizashi attacks or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Wakizashi
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. See Slash Draw.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Hamstring (3/Day)
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) slashing damage and, until the end of the creature's next turn, its AC is reduced by a value equal to its Dexterity modifier (minimum 0), and its speed is reduced by 15 feet.

reaction.name: Cleaving Parry
reaction.text: Trigger: The ronin is hit by a melee attack while wielding a melee weapon. Response: The rōnin gains a +3 bonus to its AC against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

fields.spells: Cure Wounds, Hunter's Mark, Longstrider, Earthskin (HB), Expeditious Retreat, Snakebite (HB)
fields.description:
The rōnin scarred is a solitary ranger skilled in one-on-one dueling. It typically has longstrider cast and, when ambushing, casts earthskin and snakebite before beginning combat. In the first round of a fight, the rōnin uses Hamstring, then focuses all its attacks on the hamstrung creature. To flee, it casts expeditious retreat, using the Disengage action and Dash as a bonus action.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 368 (Indie)

fields.name: Tamaya Journeyman
fields.skill: Acrobatics +7, Deception +3, Investigation +5, Sleight of Hand +7, Stealth +7

trait.name: Evasion
trait.text: When the journeyman is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
trait.text: The journeyman deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the journeyman that isn't incapacitated and the journeyman doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Tinkered Artillery (2/Short or Long Rest)
trait.text:
Before the journeyman makes a Rifle attack, it can choose to use a piece of special ammunition, choosing from the options below.

	Poisonous. On a hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the journeyman's next turn.

	Whomping. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Rifle
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage. Reload (2): the journeyman must use an action or bonus action to reload this weapon after it has been fired twice. Loud (500).

action.name: Cunning Action (Bonus Action)
action.text: The journeyman takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

action.name: Spellbomb (Bonus Action)
action.text:
The journeyman throws a spellbomb at a point within 60 feet of it, choosing a bomb from the following options, which have the effects of spells but do not require any components and last their full duration (no concentration required). The bomb doesn't detonate on landing, but requires the journeyman to take the Detonate reaction, creating the spell's effect centered on the bomb.

	• 2/day each: entangle, fog cloud
	• 1/day each: flashbang*, shatter

*See Chapter 13 - Spells

action.name: Steady Aim (Bonus Action)
action.text: The journeyman gains advantage on its next attack roll this turn. It can't use this bonus action if it has moved this turn, and after it uses it, its speed is reduced to 0 feet until the end of the turn.

reaction.name: Detonate
reaction.text: Trigger: A creature the journeyman can see ends its turn. Response: The journeyman detonates one of its spellbombs that is within 90 feet of it.

fields.spells: Entangle, Fog Cloud, Flashbang (HB), Shatter
fields.description:
A master of ambush, the tamaya journeyman is a rogue specialising in ranged attacks and debilitating spellbombs. In an ideal ambush, the journeyman gives spellbombs to its allies, and it positions itself close enough (within 90 feet) to the fray so that it can detonate the bombs whilst using its own bonus action to steady its aim. If a foe is adjacent to the journeyman's allies, the journeyman will use its Whomping ammunition to knock the target prone, giving its allies advantage on their attack rolls. Otherwise, it uses Poisonous ammunition. To flee or reposition, the journeyman takes the Disengage action, throws an entangle spellbomb, and then runs away, detonating the spellbomb once out of its area of effect.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 369 (Indie)

fields.name: Caller of Destruction

trait.name: Durable Connection
trait.text: The caller has advantage on saving throws made to maintain its concentration on its manifested spirit.

trait.name: Metamagic
trait.text:
The caller can change the spells it casts in the following ways:

	Quickened Spell (3/Day). When the caller casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can change the casting time to 1 bonus action for that casting.

	Twinned Spell (1/Day). When the caller casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can target a second creature in range with the same spell.

	Subtle Spell (3/Day). When the caller casts a spell, it can cast it without any verbal or somatic components.

trait.name: Spirit Synchronicity
trait.text: Spells the caller casts that don't have a range of self can originate from the caller's manifested spirit, instead of the caller, if it is within 120 feet of the caller.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The caller is a 14th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The caller knows the following sorcerer spells:

	• At will: earthen fist*, fire bolt, message, pins & needles*, smokescreen*(c) , soften descent*
	• 4/day each: counterspell, depth charge*, mage armor(p) , misty step
	• 2/day each: cone of cold, endure*, guardian of faith
	• 1/day each: disintegrate, teleport

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration; p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The caller knows four other sorcerer spells of 1st level or higher (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Earthen Fist
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the caller can either knock the creature prone or push it up to 15 feet directly away from the caller.

action.name: Fire Bolt
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) fire damage.

action.name: Pins & Needles
action.text:
Saving Throw: DC 17 Constitution, range 60 ft., one creature the caller can see.
Failure: 13 (3d8) psychic damage and, if the target failed its save by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Manifest Spirit (2/Short or Long Rest)
action.text: The caller conjures a spirit of destruction within 30 feet of it that remains for 10 minutes, or until the caller loses its concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). The spirit shares the caller's initiative count but takes its turn immediately after the caller. The caller can command the spirit as an action or bonus action; otherwise, the spirit takes the Dodge or Help action.

fields.spells: Earthen Fist (HB), Fire Bolt, Message, Pins & Needles (TP), Smokescreen (TP), Soften Descent (HB), Counterspell, Depth Charge (TP), Mage Armor, Misty Step, Cone of Cold, Endure (TP), Guardian of Faith, Disintegrate, Teleport
fields.description:
A caller of destruction is a sorcerer who manifests its presence into a wraith-like spirit entity. The caller of destruction moulds this entity into a swift, aggressive creature that explodes upon death, decimating those around it. When preparing for an ambush, the caller positions a guardian of faith to either block an escape or provide a barrier behind which it can hide (if its quarry is close, it uses its Subtle Spell Metamagic option to escape notice). It uses its Manifest Spirit action, commanding the spirit to hide in a shadowy, advantageous position. The caller's first spell in combat is disintegrate, which it twins using its Twinned Spell Metamagic option. It follows this up with a Quickened Spell cone of cold or depth charge, using its action to cast a cantrip. To flee, the caller casts teleport.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 370 (Indie)

fields.name: Spirit of Destruction
fields.languages: understands the languages its caller speaks

trait.name: Detonator
trait.text: When the spirit is reduced to 0 hit points, each creature of the caller's choice within 20 feet of the spirit must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 25 (2d10 + 14) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Frenzy
trait.text: The spirit has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and all attack rolls against it have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The spirit makes two attacks with any combination of Spirit Grasp and Spirit Rend.

action.name: Spirit Grasp
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) necrotic or radiant damage (caller's choice).

action.name: Spirit Rend
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) necrotic or radiant damage (caller's choice)

action.name: Detect (Bonus Action)
action.text: The spirit makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

action.name: Teleport (Bonus Action)
action.text: The spirit teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

fields.description: Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 371 (Indie)

fields.name: Shinigami Shadow String

trait.name: Talisman (2/Day)
trait.text: When the shadow string fails an ability check, it can add a d4 to the roll, potentially turning the roll into a success.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The shadow string is a 4th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The shadow string knows the following warlock spells:

	• At will: eldritch blast, mage armor(p), pins & needles*
	• 2/day each: hellish rebuke, ice moon*
	• 1/day each: mirror image, misty step

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The shadow string knows one other warlock spell of 1st level or higher (GM's choice). It can cast that spell in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Eldritch Blast
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

action.name: Pins & Needles
action.text:
Saving Throw: DC 12 Constitution, range 60 ft., one creature the shadow string can see.
Failure: 4 (1d8) psychic damage and, if the target failed the save by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Grim Puppeteer (3/Day)
action.text:
The shadow string takes control of a Large or smaller corpse or unconscious creature it can see within 60 feet of it with a CR or character level of 4 or lower, which gains 22 temporary hit points. For the next minute, or until the puppet loses its temporary hit points, the puppet shares the shadow string's initiative count and takes its turn immediately after the shadow string. The shadow string can use a bonus action on its turn to command the puppet to take an action, which can be one in its stat block (or in the stat block it had in life if it's a corpse) or some other action. The puppet can't use any reactions, legendary actions, lair actions, or any actions that create or summon additional creatures. In addition, the puppet:

	• Is treated as an Undead if it's a corpse.
	• Can't regain hit points or recover from the unconscious condition.
	• Is immune to the charmed and frightened conditions.
	• Uses the shadow string's spell attack modifier for its attack rolls (+4) and spellcasting ability modifier as a bonus to its damage rolls (+2).

When this effect ends, the shadow string can't use this action on that corpse or creature again until the shadow string finishes a long rest.

fields.spells: Eldritch Blast, Mage Armor, Pins & Needles (TP), Hellish Rebuke, Ice Moon (HB), Mirror Image, Misty Step
fields.description:
The shinigami shadow string is a warlock that has formed a pact with a shinigami. When ambushing, it has a corpse on hand, which it puppeteers moments before attacking. If it thinks it will be exposed to harm, it also casts mirror image before the fight. In combat, it tries to keep its distance, lining up foes with which to eviscerate using ice moon, and casting hellish rebuke on any combatants that hit it. If its eldritch blasts are blocked (for example, by cover), or a foe is especially well armored, it switches to pins & needles. After its third puppet has died, it runs away, using misty step if available.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 372 (Indie)

fields.name: Shinobi Adept

trait.name: Nimble Duelist
trait.text: Creatures that the adept hits with its Rapier attack (or any other Finesse weapon) can't make opportunity attacks against it until the end of the turn.

trait.name: Spells
trait.text:
The adept is a 7th-level spellcaster. It uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The adept has the following wizard spells prepared:

	• At will: dash strike*, incendiary strike*, smokescreen*(c), soften descent*
	• 2/day each: flashbang*, hellish rebuke, invisibility(c), shield
	• 1/day each: flaming tiger leap*, fly(c), slatestorm*(c), steelskin*(p)

*See Chapter 13 - Spells; c = concentration; p = pre-cast before combat

trait.name: Additional Spells
trait.text: The adept has two other wizard spells of 1st level or higher prepared from its spellbook (GM's choice). It can cast any of those other spells in place of a spell of equal level from the list above.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The adept makes two Rapier or Hand Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Shadow Striker (Bonus Action)
action.text:
When the adept hits with a weapon attack roll on its turn, it can expend one use of a spell to deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage of the attack's type and cause one of the
following effects:

	Cloud of Shadow. The adept creates a cloud of magical darkness in the space it currently occupies that lasts for 1 minute.

	Enervate. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take an extra 3 (1d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of the adept's next turn.

	Shadow Ward. The adept gains resistance to a damage type other than force or radiant (adept's choice) until the start of its next turn.

	Shadow Vanishing. Immediately after the adept makes the attack, it spends 10 feet of movement to teleport to an area of dim light or darkness it can see within 30 feet of it.

fields.spells: Dash Strike (HB), Incendiary Strike (HB), Smokescreen (TP), Soften Descent (HB), Flashbang (HB), Hellish Rebuke, Invisibility, Shield, Flaming Tiger Leap (HB), Fly, Slatestorm (HB), Steelskin (HB)
fields.description:
The shinobi adept is a wizard unafraid to move into the frontlines. It typically starts combat having already cast the steelskin spell and casts slatestorm as its first action, using its movement to cause as many creatures as possible to be affected by the spell. For its second turn, it tries to position itself to hit at least two creatures with flaming tiger leap, using the movement to bring as many people as possible into the range of the slatestorm spell, and landing next to a low AC target. From then on, it uses its weapon attacks and Shadow Striker bonus action to create Clouds of Shadow, which it moves between using Shadow Vanishing; most enemies won't know which shadow to target. When ambushing, it springs its trap with flashbang. To flee, it casts invisibility or smokescreen, moves out of melee range, and then casts fly.

Source:	Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realm p. 373 (Indie)

fields.name: Walking Hut

trait.name: Demiplane Dwelling
trait.text: The walking hut contains an entrance to a 30-foot radius demiplane furnished as a rustic household. The demiplane is dimly-lit, comfortable, and dry, regardless of the weather outside. When the hut dies, creatures inside the demiplane are expelled into the open spaces nearest to the entrance. The hut's creator can also use its action to magically expel creatures it chooses from the demiplane.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

fields.description: Source:	Complete Necromancer p. 12 (Indie)

fields.name: Duskfog
fields.languages: understands all the of its creator, but can't speak
fields.resist: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
fields.conditionImmune: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

trait.name: Misty Form
trait.text: The duskfog can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the duskfog can pass through it without squeezing. Each foot of movement in water costs it 2 extra feet, rather than 1 extra foot. The duskfog can't manipulate objects in any way that requires fingers or manual dexterity.

action.name: Misty Embrace
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 tt., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage and the duskfog regains hit points equal to half of the necrotic damage dealt.

fields.description: Source:	Complete Necromancer p. 13 (Indie)

fields.name: Slaymate

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: While the slaymate remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal toy.

trait.name: Mimicry
trait.text: The slaymate can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 11 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Scratch
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

fields.description: Source:	Complete Necromancer p. 20 (Indie)

fields.name: Erebus
fields.immune: cold, fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
fields.conditionImmune: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Erebus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Annihilator
trait.text: Erebus obliterates any nonmagical object that touches it. If an object is larger than Erebus touches it, only parts of it within 5 feet of the point of contact are disintegrated. Any creature that directly touches it takes 8d10 force damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Erebus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
trait.text: When Erebus is targeted by a spell, roll a d4. On a 1, Erebus is unaffected.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Erebus regains 50 hit points at the start of its turn. If a wish spell is used to stop Erebus's regeneration, this trait doesn't function for 10 minutes. Erebus only dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Erebus can use its Frightful Presence and its Doom Burst. It then makes four attacks using Deadlight. Erebus can either gain advantage on two of its Deadlight attacks, or it can use its Obliterate ability.

action.name: Deadlight
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) radiant damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
action.text: Each creature of the Erebus's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Erebus is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Erebus's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Doom Burst
action.text: Each creature within 60 feet of Erebus must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 39 (6d12) force damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Obliterate
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained as it is pulled into Erebus's teeth, and risks plunging into the Void beyond. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. On a successful save, the creature escapes the teeth and is no longer restrained. If the creature falls unconscious or fails three successive saves, it falls to its death and is disintegrated in the Void. No means, short of a wish spell, can return to life a creature slain by this ability.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions
legendary.text: Erebus can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Erebus regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Deadlight
legendary.text: Erebus makes one deadlight attack with advantage.

legendary.name: Move
legendary.text: Erebus moves up to half its movement speed.

legendary.name: Obliterate (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Erebus uses its Obliterate ability against one a creature within 15 feet.

fields.description:
Erebus has many names: The Dark One, the Shadow Interminable, Firstborn of Chaos, and the Last Primordial. His appearance shall certainly spell doom for the world and bring a reckoning to the gods.

	Firstborn of Chaos. From Chaos the world was born, and once again to Chaos shall it return.
	Before the primeval gods laid the universe's foundations, a groundwork upon which they could shape and form the interminable Chaos, they devised a failsafe to ensure their success. Before all else, they drew forth Erebus, a being of unmaking, from the Chaos to unravel and destroy their creations. For the gods, in their infinite wisdom, realized that not even they could forge a perfect world on the first tryindeed, countless universes were created and discarded before the gods settled for the current one, with its particular compromises and imperfections. Erebus was the tool for erasure, made to consume flawed universes and return them to the Chaos so that the gods might try again.

	Shadow Interminable. Erebus is absent in the universe today; the gods could not abide a being with the power to destroy them, and indeed, all of creation. Where Erebus has gone is another matter entirely. Most speculate that Erebus is in the Void, the plane between all other planes, devoid of existence; the destination of dead gods.
	Occult scholars claim that Erebus is a vestige, a fragment persisting in Void, slumbering and waiting for the end of time. His sigil is that of great power to binders, but none can say if the vestige is Erebus itself. But legends of the primordial gods paint a stranger picture-in ancient languages, the word Erebus means Darkness, and is used both as the name of the Dark One, and the name for the Void itself. This implies either the ancients saw no reason to distinguish between the two, or that they simply believed the two were one and the same.

	Last Primordial. Erebus appears as a thing of nightmares, an embodiment of the Void itself. Hundreds of feet long and dozens wide, without appendages of any sort, Erebus most resembles a serpent or worm, though it is not always cylindrical down its length. It is always accompanied by a haunting drone, and a rush of winds surging toward it.
	Its most striking characteristic, however, is its incredible maw. Occupying the entirety of what might otherwise be considered a face, Erebus's mouth is always open, ever-consuming, and lined with rows of sharp teeth. Even seeing into it pushes the mind to its breaking point: inside is the deepest black, a strangely enticing Void, from which escapes no light. At its edges, space warps in strange ways, giving it the appearance that everything somehow is perched precariously, ready to fall into its gaping mouth.
	Its outer skin—if it can be called that—is stretched relief of tortured faces, whose mouths are frozen in an eternal scream, exposing pinpoints of the abyss underneath. The skin, and its impressions of anguishing vestiges, appears to be paper-thin, but extraordinarily tough; there is nothing underneath it, for Erebus's true substance is the Void.

Source:	Complete Witch p. 37 (Indie)

fields.name: Bandit Ruffian

trait.name: Strength in Numbers
trait.text: The bandit has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the bandit's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Smoke Bomb
trait.text: As a bonus action, the bandit can deploy a smoke bomb to aid in escaping the fight. The smoke spreads in a circle from the point of impact and fills a 20 ft., radius. The area inside the smoke is considered heavily obscured (PHB pg. 183). Any creature inside is blinded until it exists the smoke.

action.name: Short Sword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
action.text: Ranged weapon attack:+4 to hit, range 80 ft./320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

fields.description:
The foot-soldier of any bandit gang, they dress in a patchwork of armor and wield weapons looted from the dead.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Bandits & Brigands p. 17 (Third Party)

fields.name: Bandit Heavy

trait.name: Strength in Numbers
trait.text: The bandit has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the bandit's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Human Shield
trait.text: As a reaction when attacked, the bandit heavy can attempt to seize one creature within five feet of them and use it as a shield to absorb the damage of the attack. To do so, the heavy must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the target's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics). If the heavy is successful, the target takes the damage instead of the heavy. The heavy may use an enemy or an ally as their shield. This ability does not work for area of effect damage.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The heavy makes two melee attacks with its great axe.

action.name: Great Axe
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage.

fields.description:
A cut above the common rabble, Bandit heavies are hard-hitting fighters that can deal and take more punishment than most. Big, tough, and better armed than a ruffian, these are powerful forces on the battlefield.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Bandits & Brigands p. 18 (Third Party)

fields.name: Bandit Spellsinger

trait.name: Forced Revelry
trait.text: As an action, the spellsinger hurls a flask at one creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 13) or immediately become poisoned (DMG pg. 292) as the strong smell of liquor fills the air.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
The spellsinger is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attack).

	• Cantrips (at will): Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
	• 1st level (4 slots): Pickpocket*, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield
	• 2nd level (3 slots): Misty Step, Poisoned Blade*
	• 3rd level (3 slots): Counterspell, Lemmy's Giant Stride*, Fireball
	• 4th level (2 slots): Brilliant Flash*, Ice Storm

* Spells from this book.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

fields.spells: Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Pickpocket (HB), Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield, Misty Step, Poisoned Blade (HB), Counterspell, Lemmy's Giant Stride (HB), Fireball, Brilliant Flash (HB), Ice Storm
fields.description:
Failed students, runaway apprentices, or those kicked out of their magical societies, bandit spellsingers are less skilled than a formal mage, but much tougher. Their skills are highly prized by their gangs, and they are protected as the indispensable resources they are.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Bandits & Brigands p. 19 (Third Party)

fields.name: Bandit Deceiver
fields.skill: Deception +6, Persuasion +6, Acrobatics +7, Sleight of Hand +7

trait.name: Strength in Numbers
trait.text: The bandit has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the bandit's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Fancy Footwork
trait.text: The deceiver can take the dash or disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Pickpocket
trait.text: As a reaction, the bandit deceiver can attempt to pick the pocket of someone it is engaged in combat with. The deceiver makes a Sleight of Hand (Dexterity) check against the target's AC. On a success, they abscond with 3d6 gold from the target's pocket.

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text:
The deceiver is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).

	• Cantrips (at will): Friends, Vicious Mockery, Drang's Morning After*
	• 1st level (4 slots): Charm Person, Invisibility,
	• 2nd level (3 slots): Poisoned Blade*, Knock

* Spells from this book.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The deceiver makes three attacks: one with a dagger and two with its rapier.

action.name: Rapier
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+4) piercing damage.

fields.spells: Friends, Vicious Mockery, Drang's Morning After (HB), Pickpocket (HB), Charm Person, Friends, Invisibility, Poisoned Blade (HB), Knock
fields.description:
Equally at home at a ball as on a battlefield, the bandit deceiver has a way with words and with blades. They're essential in negotiating surrender and payment terms from the gang's targets, and are adept at defending themselves if those negotiations go wrong.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Bandits & Brigands p. 20 (Third Party)

fields.name: Bandit Captain

trait.name: Tactical Retreat
trait.text: When the captain takes the Disengage action, one allied creature within 30 ft. may also Disengage as a reaction.

action.name: Bandit Commander
action.text: The captain shouts orders or signals to their allies. Each allied creature within 60 feet that can hear or see the captain and is a bandit can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack or move up to half of its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The bandit captain makes three melee attacks, two with its scimitar and one with its dagger.

action.name: Scimitar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
action.text: Ranged weapon attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft,.120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

fields.description:
Dressed in finer armor and wielding their weapon with competence, the bandit captain makes a striking figure as they command the field, making order out of chaos.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Bandits & Brigands p. 21 (Third Party)

fields.name: Bandit King
fields.skill: Acrobatics +7, Deception +7, Perception +5, Sleight of Hand +7, Stealth +7

trait.name: Aura of Infamy
trait.text: While within 30 ft. of the bandit king, allied creatures gain +2 to attack rolls and saving throws. Additionally, they advantage on saving throws against being frightened. This aura does not affect lawful aligned-creatures.

trait.name: Master Thief
trait.text: The Bandit King has advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Dexterity (Stealth), and Dexterity saving throws against traps and magical effects. Once per turn, when the Bandit King hits a creature with a weapon attack, they can attempt to steal a visible item (such as a pouch, potion or key) with a contested Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check versus the target's Wisdom (Perception).

trait.name: Sneak Attack
trait.text: The bandit king deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when they hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage on the attack roll, or if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target and isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The bandit king makes three attacks, two with his scimitar and one with his dagger or shortbow.

action.name: Scimitar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6+4) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

action.name: Command the Crew
action.text: The bandit king calls out to their allies. Up to three allied bandits within 60 feet that can hear the king may immediately move up to half their speed and make one weapon attack as a reaction.

reaction.name: Opportunity Strike
reaction.text: When a creature within 5 ft. of the bandit king is hit by an attack from another creature, the king can make one melee weapon attack against the attacker.

fields.description:
It takes a person with an iron will and a silver tongue to keep a group of bandits in line — and the bandit king has all of this and more. Strong fighters, bandit kings, thrive on battlefields where they seize command and lead their troops directly to victory.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Bandits & Brigands p. 22 (Third Party)

fields.name: Bunyip

trait.name: Aquatic Finesse
trait.text: While swimming, the bunyip does not provoke reactions.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The bunyip makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing.

action.name: Ferocious Speed (Bonus Action)
action.text: The bunyip takes the dash action.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
reaction.text: After being hit with a melee or ranged attack, the bunyip reduces damage by half.

fields.description:
An aquatic monster dwelling in rivers and streams, bunyips are shaggy-furred predators with enormous incisors capable of moving and attacking with blinding speed. They live in family groups of three to eight, and travel together in packs to hunt fish and other prey.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 12 (Third Party)

fields.name: Chupacabra

trait.name: Drink Blood
trait.text: If the chupacabra inflicts necrotic damage on a living target, it gains temporary hit points equal to the damage inflicted.

action.name: Claws
action.text: Melee weapon attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

action.name: Tongue Lash
action.text: Melee weapon attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) necrotic damage. This attack leaves no mark on the target.

action.name: Blood Stun
action.text: If the chupacabra has temporary hit points, it can use this feature to release blood energy in a wide wave. Creatures within 30 ft.of the chupacabra must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn. The chupacabra loses any temporary hit points it possesses after using this feature.

fields.description:
Chupacabras are lean, lizard-like creatures with dark hairless bodies and sinister red eyes. They feast on the blood of other creatures which they draw out with their long tongues, leaving no trace of their presence, baffling farmers. Chupacabras live in small family units in underground tunnels running just below the surface of any environment.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 13 (Third Party)

fields.name: Death Worm

trait.name: Drag
trait.text: If the death worm hits with its bite attack against a prone target of Large size or smaller, the death worm can drag the target to an unoccupied space adjacent to it after using its movement speed.

trait.name: Momentum
trait.text: If the death worm moves at least 20 ft. while burrowing it gains advantage on melee attack rolls until the end of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The death worm makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) slashing damage. If the death worm moved at least 20 ft. before attacking, the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take an additional 9 (2d8) damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Venom Spray
action.text: The death worm releases a spray of deadly venom in a 60-foot cone. Creatures in this area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, creatures suffer 27 (6d8) poison damage and are blinded until the start of the death worm's next turn. Creatures succeeding on the saving throw suffer half damage and are not blinded.

fields.description:
A death worm is a long serpentine creature with hard plates along its back. A pair of barbed horns extend from either side of its massive jaws, and the creature moves through the earth as easily as a fish swims through water. They devour meat but their digestive system is slow, so they only need to surface once every month to feed.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 14 (Third Party)

fields.name: Dropbear

trait.name: Ambush Predator
trait.text: The dropbear has advantage on initiative checks. If the dropbear has advantage on a melee attack, it deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage if it hits with the attack.

trait.name: Leap
trait.text: The dropbear can jump up to 20 ft. with a standing long jump, and while jumping the dropbear does not provoke reactions. If the dropbear makes a melee attack after jumping at least 10 ft. it gains advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Untracable
trait.text: Dropbears do not leave any tracks in their wake.

action.name: Claws
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

fields.description:
Dropbears resemble small ursine creatures with round ears and coarse, unkept fur. Their powerful back legs allow them to pounce on nearby targets with surprising force and ferocity and disappear just as quickly. They are scavengers, however, often choosing to eat corpses rather than reveal their presence.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 15 (Third Party)

fields.name: Greyhaven Devil

trait.name: Unnverving Aura
trait.text: Creatures starting their turn within 15 ft. of the Greyhaven Devil suffer disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their turn. Creatures immune to being frightened are immune to this aura.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The Greyhaven Devil makes two hoof attacks.

action.name: Hoof
action.text: Melee weapon attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Fire Breath
action.text: The Greyhaven Devil breathes a 30-foot cone of fire. Creatures caught in the cone must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, suffering 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Bray
action.text: The Grayhaven Devil lets out a horrendous bray. Creatures who can hear the bray within 120 ft. must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or suffer from the Confusion spell. Affected targets can repeat the saving throw at the end of their turn, ending the effect with a success.

fields.description:
A Grayhaven Devil is a horrendous monster with the basic shape of a malnourished horse. Its back sprouts a pair of ragged leathery wings and its head has the aspects of a fanged goat. The creature's howling bray can be heard for miles, and it seems to delight in causing fear and panic among people living in towns.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 16 (Third Party)

fields.name: Hodag
fields.languages: understands Common but doesn't speak it

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The hodag makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium size or smaller, the hodag throws the target up to 15 ft. in a direction of its choice. Targets thrown in this way must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Claws
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) slashing damage.

action.name: Perfect Camouflage (Bonus Action)
action.text: The hodag turns invisible per the invisibility spell (does not require concentration).

reaction.name: Spike Lash
reaction.text: After being hit with a melee attack, the hodag lashes out with its spikes, inflicting 15 (2d8+6) piercing damage to a target within 5 ft. of it.

fields.description:
A hodag's oversized maw is capable of tearing a person in half. They prefer to lair in dense swampy forests or shadowy cavern systems, emerging at dusk to hunt or scavenge. Hodags are voracious eaters capable of devastating entire ecosystems before moving on to fresher fields.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 18 (Third Party)

fields.name: Jackalope

trait.name: Simple Telekinesis
trait.text: The Jackalope can cast the mage hand cantrip at will without requiring components. The spectral hand is invisible.

action.name: Gore
action.text: Melee weapon attack:L +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Induce Fear
action.text: The jackalope targets a creature it can see within 60 ft. with the phantasmal killer spell (spell save DC 13) requiring no components nor concentration. The spell lasts for 1 minute or until the target succeeds on their saving throw.

action.name: Disappear (Bonus Action)
action.text: The jackalope turns invisible per the invisibility spell (does not require concentration).

fields.description:
Jackalopes are rabbit-like creatures with a rack of ornate antlers perched atop their heads and a mouth of razor-sharp teeth. Their eyes radiate strange colors when they use their otherworldly powers on victims. Jackalopes are tricksters by nature and often cause havoc with their telekinetic abilities in towns and farms.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 19 (Third Party)

fields.name: Mkole-mbembe
fields.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The mkole-mbembe can breathe both air and water.

trait.name: Trample
trait.text: If the mkole-mbembe moves at least 20 ft. toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mkole-mbembe can make one tail slap attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: River-Sentinel
trait.text: If another creature enters or damages its territory, the mkole-mbembe can sense it through subtle vibrations in the earth and water up to 120 feet away.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The mkole-mbembe makes three attacks using any combination of gore, stomp and tail slap.

action.name: Gore
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10+7) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8+7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail Slap
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

action.name: Primal Bellow
action.text: The mkole-mbembe lets out a powerful bellow. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Splash Wave
reaction.text: While in any amount of water, in response to being targeted with a melee attack, the mkole-mbembe slams its tail on the water and directs the splash at the attacker. The attacker suffers disadvantage on melee attacks targeting the mkole-mbembe until the end of its turn.

fields.description:
mkole-mbembe are massive reptilian creatures living in swamps, lakes and rivers. They have long, serpentine necks with rows of tall barbs running along its spine to the tip of their spike-lined tail. Fiercely territorial, they defend their waters with devastating charges and bone-rattling bellows, driving off hunters and monsters alike.

Source:	GM Toolkit Monthly - Cryptids p. 20 (Third Party)

fields.name: Mothman

trait.name: Flyby Move
trait.text: The mothman does not provoke reactions while flying.

trait.name: Foresight
trait.text: Roll 2d20 and record each separate result. The mothman can replace the d20 result for any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check it makes or that another creature makes within 60 ft. of it with one of these results.

trait.name: Prescience
trait.text: Then mothman sees time differently than other creatures. The mothman cannot be surprised and has advantage on initiative rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The mothman makes two gaze attacks.

action.name: Gaze
action.text: Ranged spell attack: +7 to hit, range 60/180 feet, one target. Hit: 8 (2d6+5) psychic damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6+5) slashing damage.

action.name: Stunning Gaze
action.text: The mothman's eyes flare with energy. Creatures in a 60-foot cone must make DC 13 Wisdom saving throws or be stunned until the end of their next turn.

fields.description:
The mothman is often cloaked in darkness, its humanoid form hidden beneath layers of fine hair, which muffle its movements. A pair of large, hairy wings extends from its back, and its face is dominated by a set of enormous scarlet eyes.
